sermon.title: Easter Sunday— In Christ — April 4, 2021
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: This Easter message looks at Jesus’ words on the cross. His cry from Psalm 22 recalled the whole psalm, including “I am a worm,” pointing to the crimson worm that dies to protect its young. Jesus went willingly, and believers partake of Him like daily manna. Through Him we become a new creation free of condemnation.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What did Jesus suffer before the cross?
faqs.answer: A crown of thorns was pushed into His skull; people spat on Him, beat Him and mocked Him.

faqs.question: How did God feed over a million people in the desert?
faqs.answer: He said, I will rain bread from heaven for you.
